reference_source: reference-libraries/default.json + owl template baseline. The client has no existing website of their own, so no brand tokens were auto-detectable; the palette below is authored from the brand's own meaning (Ohana / Hawaiian, volcanic) and the operator's brief for aggressive, high-contrast branding.
palette_rationale: Volcanic. Lava orange (#e24a0f) as the single loud accent against a near-black basalt (#14110f) and a warm sand ground (#f7f3ed) — Hawaiian in reference, hazard-orange in effect, which suits a demolition trade. Three colours only, so the accent never has to compete.

typography.rationale: Archivo at 800/900 is heavy and slightly condensed — it hits hard at hero scale without the readability loss of a single-weight poster face. Inter carries the body.

anti_patterns: No rows of outline icons — one icon per section maximum.
No stock photography. Every image on this site is the client's own work, pulled from their Instagram.
No invented review counts, ratings, or customer numbers.
No randomized section order — owl's fixed home order applies.
